# Multi-Tenant Isolation (Row-Level vs Database-Level)

Multi-tenant architecture: schema-per-tenant, database-per-tenant, and shared schema with PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS).

## Invariants
- ENFORCE_ROW_LEVEL_SECURITY_ON_SHARED_TABLES
- SET_TENANT_ID_SESSION_VARIABLE_ON_REQUEST
- TENANT_DATA_NEVER_LEAKS_INTO_SHARED_CACHE
